learnings: A hand-written RK4 integrator in pure Python is accurate enough to match the analytical final size.
NumPy integrates hundreds of models at once by running the same maths on whole arrays.
A seeded Monte Carlo answers probabilistic questions and reports confidence intervals.
pitfalls: Without checks like population conservation, a simulation bug looks just like a scientific result.
